Perfect! The sum of all five invoices exactly equals the payment amount of 25,800,000 paise.

**Analysis:**
- The payment is a lump_sum loan disbursal pattern (a lender funding multiple students' invoices)
- All five students named in the payment notes match the invoice customer names
- All five invoices are open and reconcile to the exact payment amount
- The invoices were issued on 2026-09-06, and the payment was captured on 2026-09-12 (within reasonable timing)

input.rationale: Loan disbursal payment from Shiksha Capital for ₹2,58,000 covers five student invoices. All student names in payment notes match invoice customers. Sum of invoices (12M + 7.5M + 2.25M + 2.25M + 1.8M = 25.8M paise) exactly equals payment amount. Standard lump_sum education lending pattern.
